title: AWS Glue Job Job Duration p95
app: AWS Glue job runs via CloudWatch to the Splunk Add-on for AWS.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=aws:glue:jobrun job_run_state="SUCCEEDED"
| eval dur_min=round(execution_time/60,2)
| stats avg(dur_min) as avg_min, p95(dur_min) as p95_min, count as runs by job_name
| where p95_min>30
| sort - p95_min
description: Computes the 95th-percentile job duration for each job in AWS Glue and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking AWS Glue jobs by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest AWS Glue timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest jobs with their owners.
visualization: Table of job by p95 job duration, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in AWS Glue so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
